node.statement: Scalar multiplication preserves calU: if U^dagger bold-dot U=J and U bold-dot R=J, then for c in U(1), conjugate-linearity of dagger and bilinearity give (cU)^dagger bold-dot(cU)=conj(c)cJ=J and (cU) bold-dot(conj(c)R)=J. The ambient map (c,U) |-> cU, restricted from complex scalar multiplication to U(1) x calU, is smooth.
